name: Vidyanshu Mishra
about: Ph.D., University of Alberta; previously a research scientist at SeeO2 Energy. Works on X-ray crystallography, machine learning and quantum calculations, currently on chalcogenides for water remediation and ML-accelerated discovery.

name: Dewin Randika Warnasinghe
about: B.Sc., University of Manitoba. Works out design principles for making new noncentrosymmetric chalcogenides.
outside_lab: Fan of horror and thriller films, and the Bourne series.

name: Vinuja Gavin Fernando
about: M.S., Boston College. Designs noncentrosymmetric chalcogenides that combine lone-pair cations with other acentric building units.
outside_lab: Into travel, politics, coin collecting, public speaking and teaching.

name: Subarna Mandal
about: B.Sc. and M.Sc., Presidency University, Kolkata. Ion-exchange materials for water remediation and 2D materials grown by chemical vapor transport.
outside_lab: Enjoys photography, writing, films and web series.

name: Kevin McGuinness
about: B.Sc., Dalhousie University, with R&D experience in fuel cells, catalysis and radiopharmaceuticals. Uses machine learning to study ion-exchange selectivity and makes new chalcohalides.

name: Duong (Lily) Phan
about: Active-learning-guided discovery of chalcohalides using halide fluxes.

name: Joshua Neufeld
about: New thiophosphate materials by reactive flux synthesis.
